decision_reason: ACTIVATE GCC: GNU local label addresses in static two-slot jump table, initialized once; doit(0) and doit(1) must produce 1 and 2 respectively or do1/do2 abort. GCC native PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS. O0 and O2 assembly contains genuine indirect JRST via jump table and both abort checks. KCC rejects GNU label values/local-label syntax; not a KCC runtime failure.

RETAIN width-or-source-adaptation: source uses Linux 32-bit kdev_t/dev_t encoding major<<22 with expected 0x15800078 and pointer->unsigned arithmetic in getname, while PDP10 native unsigned int is 36 bits. Both KCC and GCC PDP6 O0 RUN_FAIL; 36-bit shift result does not have the original 32-bit truncation. Do not change fixed Linux device encoding oracle without independently defining intended PDP10 semantics; identical PDP10 shadow remains deferred.

RETAIN hosted-runtime: ten getval calls in f, ten in f2, float-to-short conversion and original explicit arithmetic abort assertion for sum 227; also real sprintf formatting into buf. GCC PDP6 O0 cannot compile installed missing stdio.h, KCC noopt cannot link real sprintf. Removing formatting or inserting a fake sprintf would change original ABI coverage; keep intact.

RETAIN real ctype/string runtime: buildargv tokenizes a writable string using isspace and writes terminators; original main uses real strcpy/strcmp and asserts exactly a,b,NULL. GCC PDP6 O0 lacks stdio.h/ctype.h; KCC noopt links real string routines but missing isspace. Unused stdio include is not sole blocker; retain until real ctype and target headers exist, no fake isspace.

RETAIN libm: original volatile double 32.0, pow(a,1/3) and +/-0.1 tolerance must approximate 3.174802. Both GCC and KCC PDP6 O0 cannot compile missing math.h; real pow/libm not available. Keep numeric comparison intact rather than substitute a constant result.

KCC PDP6 noopt/optimized PASS; GCC O0/O1/O2/Os RUN_FAIL, all recorded. Correct the identical deferred PDP10 shadow macro guard too, retain GCC blocker and avoid duplicate registration.

GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS, O0/O2 assembly includes actual count check and call. This is empty extended asm compiler operand evaluation, not a target ISA instruction; KCC GNU extended asm unsupported.
